limitations: The operational pass count includes correctly rejected unsafe proposals;it is not a feasible-plan count.
Product engine adapters commit temporal graphs only. Domain resource findings and the evaluation-owned native resource/assignment benchmark are separate evidence.
A synthetic reviewed source or computational person identity is not a real supplier fact,admission,approval or completed physical task.
Concurrent host activity is not isolated;these are observations on a shared local machine,not dedicated performance guarantees.
Only three repetitions per benchmark. p95 is the largest of three observed samples,not a population estimate. First sample includes cold module loading.
Heap is observed immediately before and after each repetition;transient peak allocation is not instrumented. Runtime and machine differences limit comparisons.
Useful-batch time is an upper bound measured when generateCandidates returns;the runner does not instrument the first individual useful proposal.
The declared corpus is purposefully adversarial and not a statistical sample. There are no confidence intervals or claims about unseen productions.
Model,human,provider,live reconciliation and native-browser qualifications remain separately pending.
This source version is independent of the retained-rental and fresh late-day quote lifecycle units.
